item.title: [New] Defender for Office 365 threat policies switch multi-condition recipient targeting from AND to OR; an existing policy converts when an admin next edits it, and its scope can widen
item.description:
A policy written as 'users in group X AND in domain Y' becomes 'X OR Y' on its next edit, so an anti-phishing, Safe Links or Safe Attachments policy meant for a narrow population can silently start applying to a whole domain, and a stricter policy can override the one the SOC expects for those mailboxes.

Defender XDR · Before December, export the recipient conditions of every threat policy (Get-AntiPhishRule, Get-SafeLinksRule, Get-SafeAttachmentRule, Get-HostedContentFilterRule) and flag those that combine two condition types; review each one's OR scope before anyone edits it.
